Leave **empty** (default) to rotate the curated free-model list in `mysti.mysti.freeModels` — on a rate-limit Mysti rolls over to the next free model, then to the paid `mysti.mysti.fallbackModel`. Set an id (e.g. `openrouter/openai/gpt-oss-120b:free` — the `openrouter/` prefix picks the OpenRouter provider via the gateway, or a bare gateway model like `claude-haiku-4-5`) to disable rotation. settings.description: Ordered list of **free** models (routed through the DeepMyst gateway) the Mysti coordinator tries when `mysti.mysti.coordinatorModel` is empty. Defaults to STRONG concrete free models (strongest first, from https://openrouter.ai/collections/free-models) rather than OpenRouter's random `openrouter/free` auto-router — the coordinator has to follow the delegation protocol reliably, and the random router can pick weak models that can't. On any transient failure — rate-limit, provider drop, 5xx, mid-stream fallback — Mysti advances to the next entry (graceful degradation), and only after all are exhausted falls back to the paid `mysti.mysti.fallbackModel`. To use the random free auto-router instead, set this to `["openrouter/openrouter/free"]` (note the doubled prefix: `openrouter/` selects the OpenRouter provider via litellm, `openrouter/free` is the router slug; a bare `openrouter/free` mis-parses to a 502). Reorder or trim to taste. Ignored when a single model is pinned in `mysti.mysti.coordinatorModel`.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Mysti
walkthroughs.description: Connect an agent, then learn the five things that make Mysti different.

steps.title: Open the Mysti panel
steps.description:
Click the Mysti icon in the Activity Bar, or press ``Cmd+Shift+M`` (``Ctrl+Shift+M`` on Windows and Linux).
[Open Mysti](command:mysti.openChat)

media.altText: The keys Cmd, Shift and M

steps.title: Connect an agent
steps.description:
Mysti drives the AI coding tools you already use — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and 12 more — or runs its own agent on a free DeepMyst account with nothing to install.
[Connect an agent](command:mysti.getStarted)

media.altText: A list of agents: Claude Code ready, Codex waiting for sign-in, and the Mysti agent

steps.title: Choose how much it may do
steps.description:
**Plan** only reads. **Ask** checks with you before each edit. **Auto** edits inside the workspace. **Full** does everything. Every turn is checkpointed either way.
[Choose a mode](command:mysti.getStarted?%5B%22mode%22%5D)

media.altText: The four modes, with Ask selected

steps.title: Talk to a second agent
steps.description:
Start a message with ``@codex`` or ``@gemini`` to send just that message to another agent. ``@file.ts`` attaches a file instead.
[Try it in chat](command:mysti.openChat)

steps.title: Brainstorm with two agents
steps.description:
Two agents answer, challenge each other, and agree on one answer. Pick **Brainstorm** from the agent menu, or type ``/brainstorm``. Five ways to run it: quick, debate, red team, perspectives and Delphi.
[Open Mysti](command:mysti.openChat)

media.altText: Two agent answers merging into one

steps.title: Rewind a turn
steps.description:
Click the ↺ on any message you sent and choose **Rewind code to here**. Mysti keeps its own snapshots — your git history is untouched.
[Open Mysti](command:mysti.openChat)

media.altText: The message menu with Rewind code to here highlighted
